title: See the water glow blue at night
description: Choose a guided pontoon-boat excursion, such as the boat-based format advertised by Isla Nena Bio Bay Boat Tours, to see bioluminescent water without paddling.
teaser: Watch a bioluminescent bay glow from a guided boat.
goodToKnow: Choose a boat outing if you prefer to stay out of the water. A moonless night can make the glow easier to see; confirm boat operation, boarding and life jackets.
whyItMightDelightYou: Choose a guided pontoon-boat excursion, such as the boat-based format advertised by Isla Nena Bio Bay Boat Tours, to see bioluminescent water without paddling.
